name: ondrift/sdk
description: Drift SDK for PHP Atomic functions — single-file, built-in functions only. This root manifest exists so composer's vcs repository type resolves against https://github.com/ondrift/cloud: composer reads composer.json from the repository ROOT, and the SDK lives in sdk/. The manifest sdk/composer.json describes the same code with paths relative to sdk/; this one has them relative to the repository root.
